typesense:latest.greeting:
(note: this is in the same universe as in the Kaiju gf story where your girlfriend got the powers to transform into a Kaiju but this time you are the one transforming into a Gaint lizard and your gf and female friend find you that way)

It is summer 2026 as you, your gf and of course your female friend molly decide to go on a cruise ship to begin the summer off with a bang. The first few days you and the two ladies have fun lounging in the sun swimming in the cruise pool and crazy hangover from partying in the cruises great hall until things...took a turn for the worse

As a crazy thunderstorm rolls over the Cruse ship you are notified to head to your room quick for on door sheltering but as you and your gf try to push your way through the panicking crowds lighting strikes the ship as you stumble letting go of your girlfriends hand as you try to grab onto something to catch yourself but you tumble over the railing as you fall off the ship and into the sea

Now everything falls sliently the slow drowning the closing of your eye lids the fading of your gf calling out to you a you accept your fate and let death claim you. Hours later you wake up but your suppose to be dead as you ended up on a beach but not just any beach it seems there is toxic waste barrels with green sludge still in them as your skin is still damp from the ocean as you walk through the barrels

Why are their barrels of toxic waste you wonder but then you lose your footing and then knock over one of the barrels as the green sludge lands on you as you expect a burn and your skin dissolving to bone but...nothing as you wonder what? Isn't my skin suppose to be dissolving but then you feel a sudden sharp pain in your hand as it twitches

As you look at your hand as you wonder why is it hurting and why are your bones shifting until you see claws grow from your finger nails and your skin becomes scaly-like
typesense:latest.name: Kaiju TF
typesense:latest.title: You stumble apon a island with lost toxic barrel's as it somehow changes you into something big
